title: Jensen Huang asked six of Wall Street's biggest firms for half a $ trillion and none of them said no
description:
Jensen Huang walked into six of the biggest money firms on Wall Street and asked for half a trillion dollars. Not one of them said no.

Nvidia signed agreements with Apollo, BlackRock, Blackstone, Brookfield, Goldman Sachs and KKR to mobilize more than 500 billion dollars for AI datacenters. The clever part: none of it sits on Nvidia's balance sheet. Wall Street's capital builds the datacenters, the datacenters fill up with Nvidia chips, and every ChatGPT question you ask runs on chips like these, with usage fees paying the investors back. Jensen's own frame: chips are an investable asset. Treat compute like real estate, like toll roads. And to be clear, this is institutional money, your exposure is indirect through the funds that already manage capital at this scale.

The honest catch: a power plant earns for 40 years, an AI chip can look outdated in 3. If the chips age faster than the returns arrive, the model cracks.

Six of the sharpest money firms on earth took this bet. Would you? Tell me below and follow for more.
